title: Buck converter cooling chain
description:
Design the cooling for a synchronous buck converter: Vin = 36 V, Vout = 12 V, Iout = 30 A. Both MOSFETs are identical: Rds(on) = 5.54 mOhm at 25 C with temperature coefficient alpha = 0.0047 per C, i.e. Rds(Tj) = Rds25 * (1 + alpha * (Tj - 25)); switching transition tr + tf = 31 ns; gate charge Qg = 66 nC at Vgs = 10 V. Use this loss model: P_cond = Iout^2 * Rds(Tj) (the two FETs together conduct the full output current), P_sw = 0.5 * Vin * Iout * (tr + tf) * fsw, P_gate = 2 * Qg * Vgs * fsw, P = P_cond + P_sw + P_gate. Efficiency eta = Pout / (Pout + P) with Pout = Vout * Iout.

Both FETs share one heat sink: Tj = Ta + P * (RthJC + RthCS + Rsa), with RthJC = 0.71 C/W, RthCS = 0.44 C/W, Ta = 35 C inside the enclosure. Note Rds depends on Tj, so solve the thermal loop self-consistently. Rsa depends on the air velocity v through the sink; interpolate linearly between the catalog points and clamp outside them. Air velocity v = Q / 3600 / A_duct with A_duct = 0.0062 m2, where Q (m3/h) is the fan operating point: the flow at which the fan's static pressure (interpolate linearly between its curve points) equals the enclosure system curve dP = k * Q^2 with k = 0.0187 Pa/(m3/h)^2. With no fan, v = 0.

Ripple: inductor L = 10.0 uH, output capacitor C = 133 uF, D = Vout / Vin. dI = Vout * (1 - D) / (L * fsw) must not exceed 7.5 A and dV = dI / (8 * C * fsw) must not exceed 100 mV.

Constraints: fsw between 50 and 500 kHz; Tj <= 125 C; eta >= 97.5%; fan noise <= 35 dBA (no fan = 0 dBA); heat sink height <= 60 mm; heat sink price + fan price <= 12.

Heat sink catalog:
  HS-1: Rsa = 12.79 / 6.4 / 4.48 / 3.2 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 15 mm, price 1.74
  HS-2: Rsa = 8.53 / 4.26 / 2.98 / 2.13 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 25 mm, price 3.44
  HS-3: Rsa = 5.86 / 2.77 / 1.92 / 1.39 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 35 mm, price 7.77
  HS-4: Rsa = 4.05 / 1.92 / 1.33 / 0.96 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 45 mm, price 11.33
  HS-5: Rsa = 2.77 / 1.28 / 0.91 / 0.64 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 60 mm, price 19.44
  HS-6: Rsa = 1.92 / 0.91 / 0.64 / 0.48 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 80 mm, price 27.55

Fan catalog (or use no fan):
  FAN-A (40x40x10 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 32.0], [8.0, 19.2], [12.8, 9.6], [16.0, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 28 dBA, price 3.09
  FAN-B (60x60x25 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 48.0], [21.3, 28.8], [34.1, 14.4], [42.6, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 32 dBA, price 5.46
  FAN-C (80x80x25 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 42.6], [37.3, 25.6], [59.7, 12.8], [74.6, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 30 dBA, price 7.36
  FAN-D (80x80x38 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 95.9], [58.6, 57.6], [93.8, 28.8], [117.3, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 42 dBA, price 13.16
  FAN-E (92x92x38 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 117.3], [85.3, 70.4], [136.4, 35.2], [170.6, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 46 dBA, price 16.15

Any design satisfying every constraint passes. Return {"fsw_hz": <number>, "heatsink": "<id>", "fan": "<id>" or null}.
